Sail and Sink Simulator! [ᴏʀɪɢɪɴᴀʟ]

Explore the ocean and experience realistic sinking physics in an open-world destruction sandbox!

Dynamic sinking: ships sink depending on where they are hit, lights can flicker, boilers may explode, fires can spread, and wrecks slowly corrode underwater.

🌊 Travel through islands, icy regions, rocky waters, and areas filled with sea mines. Discover hidden wrecks, complete quests, level up, and unlock detailed ships!

[ᴛɪᴘ] Create a private server for best performance 📈

HISTORICAL CONTENT NOTE
Sail and Sink Simulator is a fictional, player-directed maritime sandbox. It does not recreate any specific real-world disaster, voyage, victims, or casualties. Its ships combine original vessels with stylized historic designs, while sinking scenarios result from dynamic gameplay and fictional hazards. No affiliation with any real-world entity or rights holder is claimed.
